title: Feature Complete Composable Storybook Covering the Monorepo
description: Make the root Storybook absolutely feature complete and cover the complete monorepo: a composable, data-driven scope registry (filters for starting apps/plugins), a decorator toolkit (renderer/theme/locale/terminology/platform/wasm swapping), app-boot stories for the OS shell driven by the plugin registry, and story coverage for every React-renderable surface across ui-react, framework renderer hosts, puzzle 2d/3d/5d, infinite canvas/world, cad, coda, compose, animate, and styling. Refactor away the three hardcoded scope stacks in .storybook/main.ts, clean up orphaned Storybook deps/targets/ports, and never block on cargo (use prebuilt WASM only). Executed via a workforce of parallel agents writing disjoint new story files.
